$comment: Non-200 responses of the public surfaces. Studio's Nitro error handler serialises a thrown error as { statusCode, message, ... }; clients branch on statusCode. Messages are the en dictionary entries (error-messages model) and are verified against it by tests/integration/public-api-fixtures.integration.test.ts.
